components.title: Artifacts public boundary
components.rationale: src/index.ts is the package export surface for artifact ports, runtime readers and storage implementations.

components.title: Content-addressed artifact storage
components.rationale: Owns immutable content-addressed publication and retrieval, including the S3 implementation.

components.title: Plan artifact storage ports
components.rationale: Defines read/write boundaries for plans and stored plan artifacts without owning planning decisions.

components.title: Run execution context artifacts
components.rationale: Resolves immutable run execution context references and reads their backing artifacts at runtime.

components.title: dbt project bundle artifacts
components.rationale: Reads dbt project bundles from artifact storage and validates their binding to expected execution context.

components.title: Artifact reading and integrity
components.rationale: Centralizes artifact byte reads, integrity checks and typed read failures used by runtime readers.

components.title: Compiled-code storage and enrichment
components.rationale: Current AS-IS compiled-code storage port, adapters, hashing helper and ExecutionPlan enrichment surface exported by the package.
